stage0037_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$バナージ$$
（The man named $$フル・フロンタル$$
　wants something called Laplace's Box
　hidden away inside the Unicorn...）

stage0037_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$バナージ$$
（$$カーディアス・ビスト$$... my father,
　was trying to give the Unicorn to Neo Zeon.
　Does that connect to that box...?）

stage0037_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$バナージ$$
（And $$オードリー$$ visited the Vist Foundation
　trying to stop that...）

stage0037_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$バナージ$$
（Then what should I... do...?
　Should I carry on my father's will,
　or should I help $$オードリー$$ instead...）

stage0037_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$リディ$$
「What's wrong, $$バナージ$$?
　You've got quite a face on...」

stage0037_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$... and Mr. $$カミーユ$$ too...」

stage0037_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Ever since we got back from Palau,
　you've been lost in thought a lot more」

stage0037_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「If you're torn, just step down from the Unicorn」

stage0037_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$リディ$$
「What are you saying, $$カミーユ$$...!?」

stage0037_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's for you to decide,
　you understand, $$バナージ$$?」

stage0037_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$リディ$$
「But what a waste...
　If $$バナージ$$ steps down from the Unicorn,
　that machine's as good as dead」

stage0037_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$リディ$$
「Losing that much fighting power
　would hurt, even for $c」

stage0037_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...I think great power only expands war」

stage0037_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$リディ$$
「But it takes great power
　to stop a war once it's expanded」

stage0037_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That way... the war never ends」

stage0037_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$リディ$$
「Then I'd like you to tell me.
　How you think a war should end」

stage0037_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$リディ$$
「I'm not trying to be mean.
　Anyone can talk about ideals,
　but I'm a soldier... a military man」

stage0037_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$リディ$$
「A soldier ends a war only by beating the enemy.
　That's what I fight for」

stage0037_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$リディ$$
「If things in Palau wore you out,
　you should get some rest.
　We'll cover for you while you're gone」

stage0037_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ジン$$
（That $$バナージ$$ guy...
　he's got all that power and no will to fight...）

stage0037_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ジン$$
（Maybe he got captured and mind-controlled or something...）

stage0037_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$郁絵$$
「Here... $$ジン$$, please have some too」

stage0037_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$郁絵$$
「It's a Japanese sweet called strawberry daifuku.
　It's sweet and tart, and delicious」

stage0037_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ジン$$
（A clean fusion of sweetness and tartness...!
　To think of such a bold pairing of ingredients...）

stage0037_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$モーム$$
「Master $$ジン$$, you've got bean paste
　around your mouth. Look...」

stage0037_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$モーム$$
「Ow...
　My shoulder just popped out of place...」

stage0037_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$モーム$$
「But it's fine.
　It'll pop right back in」

stage0037_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$モーム$$
「Don't worry about it, Master $$ジン$$.
　My shoulder just does that sometimes」

stage0037_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ジン$$
（What kind of body structure is that...!
　That's way too incredible, $$レア・イグラー$$!）

stage0037_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Seems you and my $$シンジ$$-chan hit it off,
　guess that makes you two of a kind～?」

stage0037_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$マオ$$
「No, no, Colonel Katsuragi～.
　Seems $$ジン$$'s not just close with $$シンジ$$,
　but with $$ユノハ$$ too～」

stage0037_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「You mean he's already got a girlfriend!?
　Kids these days move way too fast!」

stage0037_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Now, now, both of you...
　Just because it's personal time doesn't mean
　you can drink this much」

stage0037_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Whaaat～?
　Is Miss $$スズネ$$ lecturing us～?」

stage0037_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$マオ$$
「We haven't drunk that much, not that much...
　Just about a dozen canned beers between us～?」

stage0037_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That is plenty too much!
　Look, you're scaring $$ジン$$!」

stage0037_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Sorry about that～, $$ジン$$.
　Take care of $$シンジ$$-chan for me～」

stage0037_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ミサト$$
「If you make him cry,
　big sis here won't forgive you～」

stage0037_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ジン$$
（To think a capable ops commander and squad leader
　could get this out of hand...）

stage0037_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$クラン$$
「Come to think of it, this is the first time
　you've seen me in Zentradi form」

stage0037_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$クラン$$
「It's fine.
　I'm not about to step on you」

stage0037_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ジン$$
（I thought she was tiny and short,
　so how does she end up growing this big!?）

stage0037_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ジン$$
（Way too huge, $$レア・イグラー$$!）

stage0037_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ジン$$
（Makes no sense, $$レア・イグラー$$s!）

stage0037_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$シンジ$$
「That's rare...
　for Ayanami to speak to someone on her own」

stage0037_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I bet Ayanami's curious about you too, $$ジン$$」

stage0037_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$アンディ$$
「$$ジン$$ and $$シンジ$$... looks like a good pair」

stage0037_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$ジン$$ seemed bad with people at first,
　but it looks like he's okay now」

stage0037_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$アルト$$
「Once we're back in $$第２新東京市$$,
　I'll have him join the volunteer club too.
　Looking forward to it」

stage0037_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$アルト$$
「Count on you to back me up, Vice President」

stage0037_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$甲児$$
「But it's not just $$シンジ$$'s doing
　that $$ジン$$'s been fitting in with us」

stage0037_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Yeah.
　I think it's thanks to $$ユノハ$$ backing him up」

stage0037_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Seeing $$ジン$$ reminds me of who I used to be...」

stage0037_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「I... wasn't able to disappear from the start」

stage0037_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「When I transferred in, everyone
　tried talking to me at first, but I... I was too shy
　to really communicate with them...」

stage0037_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Eventually I was all alone,
　like nobody could see me anymore...」

stage0037_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「So I thought it'd be better if I really
　couldn't be seen at all, that it'd be
　easier that way... that's what I thought」

stage0037_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「I was the one in the wrong.
　Everyone welcomed me so warmly, but
　I was the one who couldn't take that step...」

stage0037_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「That's why $$ジン$$ has been on my mind...」

stage0037_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「It's okay, $$ユノハ$$.
　Both $$ジン$$ and you are our precious friends」

stage0037_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Yeah.
　Everyone's talking to $$ジン$$ too」

stage0037_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Check it out.
　Here comes someone unexpected」

stage0037_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Not you, $$シンジ$$.
　It's the new guy over there I want」

stage0037_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$カイエン$$
「I'll get straight to it.
　Who are you, really?」

stage0037_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ジン$$
「My name's Akbarjin Badbayar.
　I'm an Element cadet, as you already know」

stage0037_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$カイエン$$
「I wonder about that...
　If you hacked into Neo-DEAVA's computers,
　you could falsify the data」

stage0037_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$シンジ$$
「What's wrong, Mr. $$カイエン$$?
　Did $$ジン$$ do something?」

stage0037_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$カイエン$$
「...These past few days, I've been having nightmares...」

stage0037_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$シンジ$$
「You mean... your Element ability, Mr. $$カイエン$$...」

stage0037_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Despair Foresight...
　It's making me dream of a one-eyed giant」

stage0037_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$カイエン$$
「I don't know what it's foretelling,
　but I can't think of any cause besides your arrival」

stage0037_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Answer me, $$ジン$$...!
　Aren't you really no Element cadet at all,
　but a spy for the enemy!」

stage0037_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ジン$$
「And here I thought you'd say something,
　but it's something that stupid...」

stage0037_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Look out, $$ユノハ$$!
　The crane's falling!!」

stage0037_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「I-I'm fine...!
　$$ジン$$ protected me, so...」

stage0037_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「More like space itself was severed,
　blocking the physical impact!」

stage0037_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Awesome, $$ジン$$!
　So this is your Element ability!」

stage0037_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I'll call it, the Severing Force!
　...how about that?」

stage0037_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Since he showed an Element ability,
　that clears $$ジン$$ of being a spy, right?」

stage0037_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$アストナージ$$
「Sorry, everyone!
　Is anyone hurt!?」

stage0037_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Do be more careful, $$アストナージ$$」

stage0037_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「We're fine over here.
　$$ジン$$ protected $$ユノハ$$」

stage0037_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Amazing, $$ジン$$!
　Now you'll get to ride Aquarion soon too!」

stage0037_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「...Confirmed the Unicorn's NT-D activation.
　It appears to be engaging the $$クシャトリヤ$$」

stage0037_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「The Psycho-Monitor's sensitivity looks good too.
　No issues monitoring from here on」

stage0037_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Just as you intended, Colonel」

stage0037_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「To activate the NT-D, there's no way
　but to pit it against a suspected Newtype」

stage0037_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「The Psycho-Monitor fitted to the Unicorn
　in Palau will intercept the NT-D's activation」

stage0037_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That should let us gather the Laplace
　Program data we couldn't
　analyze on our own」

stage0037_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Still, to think even an Enhanced Human
　could activate the NT-D...」

stage0037_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「An Enhanced Human can't be called a true Newtype.
　But with no one able to say what a true Newtype
　even is, what we need is the phenomenon itself」

stage0037_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「That brat called $$バナージ$$...
　will he really be able to master the Unicorn?」

stage0037_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Once swallowed by the NT-D,
　one could say his own skill hardly matters」

stage0037_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Right now, the NT-D system is what moves
　that machine. The pilot's just a processor now,
　converting received brainwaves into hostility」

stage0037_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「The NT-D... what a terrifying system」

stage0037_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Newtype Destroyer System...
　Once it identifies the enemy as a Newtype,
　the machine's limiters release」

stage0037_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「A hunting machine with a paranormal
　interface born of the Psycoframe」

stage0037_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「As the system matures further,
　it may gain power to dominate enemy Psycommu weapons」

stage0037_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「That machine... no ordinary person could handle it...!」

stage0037_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's right.
　Which is precisely why we need an Enhanced Human」

stage0037_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's the plan known as the UC Project.
　Once the Enhanced Human, tech's own product,
　drives it out, the Newtype is buried for good」

stage0037_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Then, Lieutenant $$マリーダ$$ is...」

stage0037_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Pitiable, but she'll have to be sacrificed.
　She's endured such a harsh fate,
　it's about time she was allowed to rest」

stage0037_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Proto Ple Twelve...
　The artificial Newtype project through cloning...」

stage0037_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「To her, the twelfth prototype...
　let us pay our respects, Lieutenant $$マリーダ・クルス$$」

stage0037_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$バナージ$$
（But, it's no use...
　My body... won't move...）

stage0037_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Wake up, $$バナージ$$!
　Reject the Unicorn, the NT-D!」

stage0037_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't lose to the machine!
　You're fighting on your own will, aren't you!」

stage0037_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't let the Unicorn become a devil's machine!
　At this rate, it'll become something that kills
　the Newtype's existence, humanity's potential!」

stage0037_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$バナージ$$
（The future... hope...
　Ending the war... understanding someone...
　coming together... that is...）

stage0037_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ジン$$
（Why...
　Why haven't I given $$イズモ$$ a status report,
　or answered $$カグラ$$'s calls...）

stage0037_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Let's go meet $$バナージ$$ together.
　Everyone's already gathered」

stage0037_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Of course you can.
　You were worried about $$バナージ$$ too, $$ジン$$」

stage0037_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Good work, $$カミーユ$$.
　Zeta made it back safe too, I see」

stage0037_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「But, Captain $$アムロ$$...
　why was Lieutenant $$アポリー$$, who'd gone missing...?」

stage0037_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$チェーン$$
「That part, we're not too sure of either」

stage0037_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$チェーン$$
「Even with pressure from the Ruo Company,
　the Zeta kept in storage at Anaheim
　couldn't be moved before...」

stage0037_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「And the fact that it's been delivered
　to $c like this means Anaheim faced
　pressure greater than the Ruo Company's」

stage0037_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I think... Captain $$クワトロ$$...
　no, $$シャア$$ made a move」

stage0037_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$チェーン$$
「Neo Zeon went out of its way
　to lend $c a hand?」

stage0037_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Neo Zeon's a client of Anaheim's too,
　and Lieutenant $$アポリー$$ is his personal aide.
　It's not an impossible story」

stage0037_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$チェーン$$
「But why would he go that far...?」

stage0037_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But $$フル・フロンタル$$ might have
　something to do with it」

stage0037_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Looking at the fights so far,
　that man, $$フル・フロンタル$$,
　is making moves apart from the overall strategy」

stage0037_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$チェーン$$
「So $$シャア$$ helped reinforce $c
　just to keep that in check?」

stage0037_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...It's only a possibility, that's all」

stage0037_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't like being moved around
　in $$シャア$$'s palm?」

stage0037_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「It doesn't matter.
　I'm not torn anymore」

stage0037_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That word, Laplace, that I heard
　when I touched $$バナージ$$'s mind bothers me」

stage0037_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I don't know what it means.
　But $$バナージ$$ seemed to feel
　torn about that word」

stage0037_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$チェーン$$
「Why not just ask him yourself?」

stage0037_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「No...
　Since $$バナージ$$'s hiding it himself,
　we should just watch and wait」

stage0037_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「My gut says it's connected to the Unicorn, but...」

stage0037_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Asking Mr. $$アルベルト$$ would be pointless.
　Same with the NT-D, that machine's secrets
　are probably sacred to him」

stage0037_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The Unicorn's secret...
　Maybe that's what Neo Zeon, no,
　what $$フル・フロンタル$$ is after too」

stage0037_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It's not out of the question...
　But I'd rather not have any more preconceptions
　about a Unicorn that's already so unclear」

stage0037_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll report this to $$ブライト$$ myself,
　but keep it between us for now」

stage0037_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$アムロ$$
「We shook the pursuit force off in that fight.
　$c will head down to Earth
　to look into the situation, it seems」

stage0037_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「What will Neo Zeon do next, I wonder...」

stage0037_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$アムロ$$
「HQ's already packed with Earth supremacists,
　and plans to raise a fleet to meet Neo Zeon head-on」

stage0037_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$チェーン$$
「So it'll be all-out war...」

stage0037_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Had confirming wartime law between us been delayed,
　those supremacists might have ordered
　indiscriminate attacks on the colonies...」

stage0037_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Did he see this coming...」

stage0037_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That doesn't mean I'll accept his methods」

stage0037_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If possible, I'd like to end this war
　quickly by taking down $$シャア$$...」

stage0037_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Captain $$クワトロ$$...
　We'll walk our own path）

stage0037_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（If you're the one who gave me the Zeta,
　then I'll simply fight with its power.
　To stop you... to stop this war...）

stage0037_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I'm sorry, $$アマタ$$...
　I... don't understand myself anymore...」

stage0037_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Watching that person makes me so sad...
　I'm terrified, and yet... I feel this nostalgia...」

stage0037_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（A man and woman, out of step...
　Fond of each other, yet their too-long spring
　lets a cold draft blow between their hearts...）

stage0037_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（And into that gap steps another man...
　Ah... a maiden's heart torn a thousand ways...）

stage0037_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（This situation is too much...!
　Their heartbeats are churning out Z-Chips like crazy!）

stage0037_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（That sum... 150 Z!
　I'll add this to the squad's stockpile）

stage0037_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Now then, I'll enjoy watching the rest myself.
　Ah... where will these three's 12,000 years of love lead...）

stage0037_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well done, Master $$バナージ$$.
　So you've finally mastered the Unicorn」

stage0037_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$バナージ$$
「There's still plenty I don't understand, though」

stage0037_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For now, may I borrow your hand, Master $$バナージ$$...」

stage0037_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For the $$ジェニオン$$'s GAI Mode, I don't
　know the activation conditions, and $n
　loses to Master $$バナージ$$ in simulations...」

stage0037_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「At this rate, I'll brew Master $$バナージ$$'s
　toenail grime and have $n gulp it down...」

stage0037_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...Over there, $n...
　is giving us a teary look」

stage0037_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This won't do...!
　$n's dangerous once that look appears!」

stage0037_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We must cover for this, quickly!
　Now, Master $$バナージ$$! Lend us your strength!」

stage0037_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「All right, here we go!
　Let's get fired up today too...」
